verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own site says users can bring their own API keys or existing Codex/Claude subscriptions, or pick any model through OpenRouter, with no markup on inference. It also supports routing model traffic through an approved gateway, so agents run on the model the lead chooses. Missing for 10: in-depth configuration docs (per-agent or per-task model selection, supported providers), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice

citations.quote: Bring your own API keys or existing Codex and Claude subscriptions, or pick any model through OpenRouter. No lock-in, no markup on inference.
Route model traffic through your approved gateway so access policies and model usage remain under your control.
